```yaml
name: Update Nix vendor hash

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - go.mod
      - go.sum
      - '**/*.nix'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Set up Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v27
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-unstable

      - name: Run vendor hash update script
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/update-vendorhash.sh
          scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: update Nix vendorHash"

      - name: Push changes
        id: push
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git push
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Determine push success
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        id: push_success
        run: |
          echo "success=${{ steps.push.outcome == 'success' }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create new branch for PR
        if: steps.push_success.outputs.success == 'false' && steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git checkout -b update-vendorhash-${{ github.sha }}
          git push --set-upstream origin update-vendorhash-${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.push_success.outputs.success == 'false' && steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: "chore: update Nix vendorHash"
          body: |
            Automated update of Nix vendorHash based on dependency changes.
          commit-message: "chore: update Nix vendorHash"
          branch: update-vendorhash-${{ github.sha }}
          base: ${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
```
